partners.mechanism_chain: PEX10 (HGNC:8721) —DISRUPTS→ Peroxisome biogenesis and function (GO:0008544); Peroxisome biogenesis and function (GO:0008544) —LEADS_TO→ Cerebral abnormalities (HP:0001274); PRKDC (HGNC:9344) —DISRUPTS→ DNA repair (GO:0006281); DNA repair (GO:0006281) —LEADS_TO→ Severe combined immunodeficiency (HP:0001799); DNA repair (GO:0006281) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal T cell proliferation (HP:0005321); DNA repair (GO:0006281) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal B cell proliferation (HP:0005322).
